command: set -e; test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77; F=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_daemon.py; sha256sum "$F"; grep -n -e 'CONTROL_BRANCH' -e 'RESULTS_BRANCH' -e 'HOST' -e 'machine_id' -e 'target_host' -e 'command_id' "$F" | head -180; systemctl --user status frankenstein-local-bridge.service --no-pager -l | head -80 || true
